If you cancel the order, you'll take a metrics hit.  On a major e-commerce platform, its typically best to incorporate the shipping price into the item price and have it listed as 'Free Shipping'.  Typically this is how you'll want to price:

`Retail Price = Landed Wholesale Cost + Expected Profit + Freight Cost + Platform Commissions`

Typically before you list anything, you need to figure out your pricing, because once the item is sold, you're essentially committed to fulfilling the order regardless of the price you listed it at.
